label: Rafael Santiago Arano Rodríguez, «El Piña», first identified as a suspect
quote: Rafael Santiago Arano Rodríguez, “El Piña,” was first identified as a suspect in November 2022

label: El Piña imprisoned in a state facility in Nuevo Laredo since 2023; trial delayed by defence appeals
quote: has been imprisoned  in a state facility in Nuevo Laredo since 2023 for alleged responsibility in the crime, though the trial has been delayed by defence appeals

label: Shot at by assailants in a white Honda pickup truck on a road in the Fundó Legal neighbourhood of Ciudad Obregón
quote: On 17 July 2022, at approximately 2:00 a.m., assailants in a white Honda pickup truck pulled alongside Haro’s car on a road in the Fundó Legal neighbourhood of Ciudad Obregón and fired five shots at him.

label: Haro’s news outlet publishes two videos of shootings in Ciudad Obregón, approximately one hour before the shooting
quote: Approximately one hour before the shooting, Haro’s news outlet had published two videos of shootings in Ciudad Obregón.

label: Haro tells CPJ that he had never previously received threats or been targeted
quote: Haro told CPJ that he had never previously received threats or been targeted.

quote: Sonora’s Attorney General’s Office opened an investigation and referred the case to the FEADLE Sonora office.

label: Haro contacts the federal Protection Mechanism with a view to joining a protection programme; outcome not publicly available
quote: Following the attack, Haro contacted the federal Protection Mechanism with a view to joining a protection programme, but no further details are publicly available regarding the outcome.

label: ARTICLE 19 discloses a history of threats against Méndez dating back seven years, linked to the administration of the late mayor of San Luis de la Paz, Guanajuato, Timoteo Villa
quote: While he primarily covered general news, ARTICLE 19 disclosed that he had a history of threats dating back seven years, linked to the administration of the late mayor of San Luis de la Paz, Guanajuato, Timoteo Villa.

label: Shot and killed along with two other people at a bar that he owned, at approximately 23:00; two others injured in the attack
quote: On 2 August 2022, Méndez was shot and killed along with two other people at a bar that he owned, at approximately 23:00. Two others were injured in the attack.

label: SSPC reports the murder was related to extortion of the family business and announces the arrest of one suspect, Roberto “N,” one of two alleged perpetrators; no further update provided
quote: On 11 August 2022, the SSPC reported that the murder was related to the extortion of the family business and announced the arrest of one suspect, Roberto “N,” identified as one of two alleged perpetrators. No further update has been provided.

label: Killed by an armed group while recording a promotional segment outside a Little Caesar’s pizzeria on Ejército Nacional Avenue in Ciudad Juárez
quote: On 11 August 2022, Allan González, a radio announcer at Switch 105.9 FM, along with three non-editorial colleagues—including Armando Guerrero, the operations manager, as well as Lino Flores and Alejandro Arriaga—were recording a promotional segment with a mobile unit outside a Little Caesar’s pizzeria on Ejército Nacional Avenue in Ciudad Juárez when they were killed by an armed group.

label: Six members of Los Mexicles arrested for participation in the violent acts
quote: Six members of Los Mexicles were arrested for their participation in the violent acts.

label: Other employees of the radio station receive threats related to their coverage of the events
quote: Following the attack, other employees of the radio station received threats related to their coverage of the events.

label: Román's phone targeted with telecommunications surveillance infrastructure, per investigative reporting by Lighthouse Reports and Haaretz
quote: investigative reporting by Lighthouse Reports and Haaretz revealed that, on 21 August 2022—the day before Román’s murder—his phone was targeted using telecommunications surveillance infrastructure

label: Final column published on Facebook, less than an hour before the killing
quote: In his final published column, posted on Facebook less than an hour before his execution and titled “State Crime without Blaming the Boss,” Román wrote about the Ayotzinapa case and criticized President AMLO for “exonerating” his predecessor Enrique Peña Nieto of responsibility.

label: Shot dead outside his home by two men on a motorcycle
quote: On 22 August 2022, at approximately 4:30 p.m., two men on a motorcycle approached Román as he got into his car outside his home and shot him dead.

label: His son Bladimir Román shot and killed in Ocotito — a separate incident, not one of the 75
quote: His death came just one month after his son, Bladimir Román, was shot and killed in Ocotito.

label: At the funeral, relatives state they had received death threats from alleged members of organized crime
quote: During the funeral procession, Román’s relatives revealed that they had received death threats from alleged members of organized crime.

date_as_written: On the same day as Román’s funeral
label: More than fifty journalists protest against impunity outside the Attorney General's Office in Mexico City
quote: On the same day as Román’s funeral, more than fifty journalists protested against impunity for the killing of Román and other Mexican journalists outside the Attorney General’s Office in Mexico City.

label: Guerrero Attorney General's Office opens an investigation into the murder, examining a work motive and a link to his son's killing
quote: The Guerrero Attorney General’s Office opened an investigation examining whether Román’s journalistic work motivated the murder and whether it was connected to his son’s killing.

label: José “N,” alias “El Deibi,” arrested for Román's murder
quote: In February 2023, José “N,” alias “El Deibi,” was arrested for Román’s murder.

label: Formally charged with Román's murder; no public updates since
quote: He was formally charged with Román’s murder in April 2023; no public updates on the case have been shared since.

label: Creates Chiapas Denuncia YA, a Facebook-based news outlet, in October 2018
quote: a Facebook-based news outlet he created in October 2018 covering local and state politics, public security, and citizen complaints of alleged official corruption and abuse in the Comitán de Domínguez region of Chiapas

label: Last seen in Comitán de Domínguez, La Pileta neighborhood, at approximately 11:30 a.m., per the missing-person report his wife filed with the FGE
quote: On the morning of 20 September 2022, at approximately 11:30 a.m., Flores Mendoza was last seen in the city of Comitán de Domínguez, in the La Pileta neighborhood, according to the missing-person report his wife filed with the FGE of Chiapas.

label: Relatives tell local media he was intercepted by men in a pickup truck while driving; the official FGE bulletin records only that he was last seen by his wife
quote: Relatives told local media that he had been intercepted by men traveling in a pickup truck while driving his own vehicle; the official FGE bulletin records only that he was last seen by his wife and does not characterize the disappearance as an abduction.

label: The FGE opens an investigation
quote: The FGE opened an investigation

label: State authorities notify the federal Comisión Nacional de Búsqueda on 21 September
quote: state authorities notified the federal Comisión Nacional de Búsqueda on 21 September

label: An FGE spokesperson tells CPJ that authorities had not determined whether Flores was abducted and, as of the following week, had not established a connection to his journalistic work
quote: A spokesperson for the FGE told CPJ that authorities had not yet determined whether Flores was abducted, and as of the following week authorities had not established whether the case was connected to his journalistic work.

label: Chiapas Denuncia YA's report on criminal gangs is posted around the time of the disappearance and removed shortly afterward; outlets report it concerned an alleged internal dispute within the Sinaloa Cartel
quote: Around the time of his disappearance, Chiapas Denuncia YA had posted a report about criminal gangs in the area, which was removed shortly afterward; multiple outlets reported that the deleted post concerned an alleged internal dispute within the Sinaloa Cartel in Chiapas.

label: ARTICLE 19 reports that Flores had indicated he was the target of intimidating messages and that his final post, addressing organized crime, was removed on 19 September
quote: ARTICLE 19 documented the case and reported, based on testimony it gathered, that Flores had indicated he was the target of intimidating messages and that his final post, addressing organized crime, was removed on 19 September.

label: ARTICLE 19 urges the Chiapas government and the federal Secretaría de Gobernación to coordinate with the Comisión Nacional de Búsqueda under the Homologated Search Protocol; CPJ calls for a credible and exhaustive investigation
quote: ARTICLE 19 urged the Chiapas government and the federal Secretaría de Gobernación to coordinate with the Comisión Nacional de Búsqueda under the Protocolo Homologado para la Búsqueda de Personas, and CPJ called on Mexican authorities to undertake a credible and exhaustive investigation, noting that 2022 was the deadliest year on record for the country's press

label: AMLO introduces the weekly segment “Who’s Who in Lies” to his morning press conference, used to publicly single out and discredit journalists and media figures
quote: In 2021, AMLO introduced a weekly segment to his morning press conference, “Who’s Who in Lies,” which was used to publicly single out and discredit journalists and media figures.

label: The President targets Gómez Leyva and two other journalists in the “Who’s Who in Lies” segment broadcast two days before the assassination attempt
quote: In the segment broadcast on 14 December 2022, two days before Gómez Leyva’s assassination attempt, the President targeted him and two other journalists, stating that “if you listen to them too much, you might even develop a brain tumour.”

label: Motorcycle assailants open fire on Gómez Leyva’s vehicle while he drives through Coyoacán Avenue; he survives because of the vehicle’s armoured plating and bulletproof windows
quote: On the evening of 15 December 2022, Gómez Leyva was driving through Coyoacán Avenue in southern Mexico City when a motorcycle carrying two individuals approached his vehicle. One of the riders turned, drew a firearm, pointed it at the journalist’s head, and opened fire. Gómez Leyva survived solely because the vehicle’s armoured plating and bulletproof windows stopped the rounds.

label: Gómez Leyva’s network provides him an armoured car for the short nightly journey between the studio and his house
quote: The armoured car had been provided to him by his network for the short nightly journey between the studio and his house

label: Earlier threats related to Gómez Leyva’s reporting on Mexico’s northern prisons
quote: following earlier threats related to his reporting on Mexico’s northern prisons

label: Mexico City Public Security Minister Omar García Harfuch holds a press conference sharing security camera footage and preliminary details about the attackers
quote: Mexico City Public Security Minister Omar García Harfuch held a press conference in which he shared security camera footage and preliminary details about the attackers.

label: 16 people arrested in connection to the attempted murder
quote: In January 2023, 16 people were arrested in connection to the attempted murder.

label: Gómez Leyva retires from his television programme and relocates to Madrid, Spain, from where he continues to host his radio show
quote: In October 2024, Gómez Leyva retired from his television programme and relocated to Madrid, Spain, from where he continues to host his radio show.

label: Pool Pedro Gómez Jaramillo and Héctor Eduardo Martínez Jiménez plead guilty to attempted murder and criminal association; sentenced to 12 and 14 years in prison respectively
quote: In June 2025, Pool Pedro Gómez Jaramillo, alias “El Pool,” and Héctor Eduardo Martínez Jiménez, alias “El Bart,” pled guilty to attempted murder and criminal association, receiving sentences of 12 and 14 years in prison respectively.

label: Armando Escárcega, considered the mastermind of the attack, arrested in California
quote: Armando Escárcega, alias “El Patrón,” considered the mastermind of the attack, was arrested in October 2024 in California.

label: Armando Escárcega sentenced to 14 years in prison
quote: He was sentenced to 14 years in prison.

label: García Aguilar kidnapped along with Pintor Alegre and Moreno; the three held together; Benítez Santos kidnapped separately
quote: On 27 December 2022, García Aguilar was kidnapped, along with fellow journalist Jesús Pintor Alegre and website administrator Fernando Moreno. The three were abducted separately but held together. A fourth individual, José Alberto Benítez Santos, a municipal employee, was kidnapped separately after being mistaken for one of the page’s administrators.

label: Pintor Alegre recounts being questioned, beaten, and accused of being the page's administrator
quote: Pintor Alegre later recounted being questioned, beaten, and accused of being the administrator of Escenario Calentano.

label: Perpetrators post a video of the three chained captives on the Escenario Calentano Facebook page; García Aguilar states he founded the page
quote: A video was posted by the perpetrators on the Escenario Calentano Facebook page itself, showing two of the captives, García Aguilar and Moreno, chained hand and foot, with García Aguilar stating: “Escenario Calentano was created five years ago; I was the one who founded the page.”

label: Captors' accompanying message threatens «sooner or later we'll catch the assholes»
quote: The captors’ accompanying message allegedly read: “So you can see that sooner or later we’ll catch the assholes.”

label: Guerrero State Attorney General's office issues two statements that it is investigating the kidnapping
quote: On 10 and 11 January 2023, the Guerrero State Attorney General’s office issued two statements that they were investigating the kidnapping.

label: Pintor Alegre and Moreno released
quote: Pintor Alegre and Moreno were released on 11 January 2023

label: Benítez Santos released
quote: Benítez Santos was released on 22 January 2023

label: García Aguilar remains forcibly disappeared
quote: Alan García Aguilar remains forcibly disappeared.

label: Multiple sources attribute responsibility to La Familia Michoacana
quote: Multiple sources attribute responsibility to La Familia Michoacana.

label: No prosecutions reported; no public legal follow-up on the surviving victims
quote: No prosecutions have been reported, and no legal follow-up on the cases of the surviving victims has been publicly disclosed.

label: Served as Director of Public Safety and Government for the Tehuacán City Council for nine months in 2019
quote: Ramírez Hernández had also served as the Director of Public Safety and Government for the Tehuacán City Council for nine months in 2019, during which time he contributed to the dismantling of a criminal organisation involved in fuel smuggling, drug trafficking, and human trafficking.

label: Members of the “Bigotonas” criminal gang apprehended during his tenure; later identified by investigators as a potential motive for his assassination
quote: During that tenure, members of the “Bigotonas” criminal gang were apprehended, which investigators allegedly identified later as a potential motive for his assassination.

label: Killed by gunfire from two armed men while boarding his vehicle in the Fraccionamiento Agua Blanca, Tehuacán
quote: On 23 May 2023, at approximately 1:45 p.m., Ramírez Hernández was leaving a residence and boarding his vehicle in the Fraccionamiento Agua Blanca in Tehuacán when two armed men approached and opened fire, striking him at least five times. His vehicle subsequently struck a tree. Ramírez Hernández died at the scene.

label: ARTICLE 19 and CNDH reportedly request protective measures for the family; implementation unclear
quote: ARTICLE 19 reportedly requested protective measures for his family following the killing, as did CNDH, though it is unclear whether such measures were ever implemented.

label: OHCHR in Mexico calls for a prompt and effective investigation including the victim’s journalistic work as a line of inquiry
quote: The OHCHR in Mexico called upon the authorities to redouble efforts for a prompt and effective investigation and to include the victim’s journalistic work as a line of inquiry.

label: UNESCO Director-General condemns the killing and urges accountability
quote: The UNESCO Director-General condemned the killing and urged accountability.

label: RSF demands an exhaustive investigation
quote: RSF demanded an exhaustive investigation.

label: CNDH announces it will monitor the state of Puebla’s investigation into the killing
quote: On 26 May 2023, CNDH announced it would monitor the state of Puebla’s investigation into Ramírez Hernández’s killing.

label: José Francisco N. arrested for drug trafficking
quote: On 31 May 2023, José Francisco N. was arrested for drug trafficking

label: José Francisco N. charged on 12 July with aggravated homicide in the murder of Ramírez Hernández
quote: was charged on 12 July for aggravated homicide in the murder of Ramírez Hernández

label: Jesús Armando N., alias “El Güero”, arrested for the murder of Ramírez Hernández
quote: In September 2024, Jesús Armando N., alias “El Güero” was arrested by the Attorney General's Office of the State of Puebla and the State Public Security Secretariat for the murder of Ramírez Hernández

label: Tribunal de Enjuiciamiento of the Judicial Branch of Puebla finds Jesús Armando N. and José Francisco N. guilty of aggravated intentional homicide
quote: on 16 February 2026, the Tribunal de Enjuiciamiento of the Judicial Branch of Puebla found Jesús Armando N. and José Francisco N. guilty of aggravated intentional homicide

label: Both sentenced to 46 years and five months of imprisonment
quote: On 26 February 2026, both were sentenced to 46 years and five months of imprisonment.

label: A third implicated individual remains a fugitive; the intellectual authors of the crime have not been identified
quote: A third implicated individual remains a fugitive, and the intellectual authors of the crime have not been identified.

label: Last seen in the Factoría area of Nanchital and allegedly abducted by unknown individuals in a white van
quote: On the morning of 6 July 2023, Hinojosa Viveros was last seen in the Factoría area of Nanchital, in the vicinity of the Pemex complex. He was allegedly intercepted by unknown individuals who abducted him in a white van.

label: Family seeks to halt any advocacy or additional investigation beyond the FGE's and has not spoken with any media
quote: Reporting indicates that the journalist’s family has sought to halt any advocacy or additional investigation not completed by the Veracruz Attorney General’s Office; they have not spoken with any media.

label: Family successfully lobbies the Veracruz State Commission for the Attention and Protection of Journalists to stop collaborating with the FGE
quote: They successfully lobbied the Veracruz State Commission for the Attention and Protection of Journalists to stop collaborating with the FGE.

date_as_written: Three days prior to his disappearance
label: Publishes an article on the recovery of eight bodies from a clandestine grave
quote: Three days prior to his disappearance, Sánchez Íñiguez published an article relaying information from the state prosecutor’s office concerning the recovery of eight bodies from a clandestine grave known as “Devil’s Cave,” situated on the northern slope of San Juan Hill, between the limits of Tepic and the municipality of Xalisco.

label: Returns alone to the family residence in Tepic; his wife last speaks with him that evening
quote: Sánchez Íñiguez’s wife, Cecilia López, last spoke to him on the evening of 5 July 2023 after he returned alone to the family residence in Tepic following a visit to a nearby town.

label: Stops answering his mobile phone; his son finds him gone from the residence with his laptop, phone and La Jornada press credential
quote: The next day, when he ceased answering his mobile phone, López’s son went to the residence and discovered that his father was gone, along with his laptop computer, mobile phone, and his La Jornada press credential.

label: Body found bound with signs of torture in El Ahuacate near Tepic
quote: On 8 July 2023, Sánchez Íñiguez’s body was discovered in the village of El Ahuacate near Tepic, bearing clear signs of torture.

label: La Jornada reports his computer and digital storage devices were taken from his home
quote: La Jornada subsequently reported that Sánchez Íñiguez’s computer and digital storage devices had been taken from his home, suggesting the perpetrators sought to seize evidence of his investigative work.

label: Authorities estimate the body had been at the site for 24 to 48 hours
quote: Authorities estimated that the body had been at the site for 24 to 48 hours before discovery.

label: Nayarit State Attorney General's office publishes a statement acknowledging the work-motive
quote: The Nayarit State Attorney General’s office published a statement acknowledging that Sánchez Íñiguez’s work as a journalist was a significant motive for his killing.

label: FEADLE assumes jurisdiction over the case
quote: By 14 July, FEADLE assumed jurisdiction over the case.

label: Juseff Farid “N” arrested for and charged with the murder
quote: In May 2025, Juseff Farid “N” was arrested for and charged with Sánchez Íñiguez’s murder.

label: District judge alleges Farid “N” participated in the kidnapping and murder along with two others
quote: The district judge alleged that Farid “N” participated in the kidnapping and murder of the journalist along with two others.

label: Matus survives an armed attack
quote: In 2017, he survived an armed attack.

label: Individuals open fire on Matus while he is driving his vehicle; he escapes unharmed
quote: In 2019, individuals opened fire on him while he was driving his vehicle; on that occasion he escaped unharmed.

label: In the days immediately preceding his death, Matus's outlet publishes several byline-less stories on violent incidents and deadly shootouts in Acapulco
quote: In the days immediately preceding his death, his outlet published several stories without bylines covering violent incidents and deadly shootouts in Acapulco, consistent with an environment in which the journalists were aware of the personal risks their reporting entailed.

label: Shot twice, including once in the head, in the parking lot of a Coppel department store in the Emiliano Zapata neighbourhood, Acapulco
quote: On 15 July 2023, at approximately 3:00 p.m., Matus was shot twice—including once in the head—while standing outside his vehicle in the parking lot of a Coppel department store in the Emiliano Zapata neighbourhood on Vicente Guerrero Avenue in Acapulco.

label: Some reporting indicates Matus was alive when found and died en route to the hospital
quote: Some reporting indicates that Matus was alive when he was found, and died en-route to the hospital.

label: Authorities seek to distance the killing from Matus's journalistic work; officials circulate suggestions that he was tipped off by criminals or acted as a cartel spokesman
quote: Authorities in Guerrero sought to distance the killing from Matus’s journalistic work. Officials circulated suggestions that the speed with which Matus arrived at crime scenes indicated he was being tipped off by criminals as early as 2017, and that a rumour was disseminated that the journalist was acting as a spokesman for a cartel.

label: Press freedom organizations identify the officials' response as characteristic of the criminalization of journalists in Mexico
quote: Press freedom organizations identified this as characteristic of the criminalization of journalists by authorities in Mexico at large—whereby officials deflect responsibility by impugning the character of murdered reporters.

label: No arrests made in connection with the killing; the case remains unsolved
quote: No arrests have been made in connection with the killing. The case remains unsolved.

label: Killed by gunfire from a vehicle outside his home in the Colonia Aviación neighbourhood; one police officer also killed, three wounded
quote: In the early hours of 25 September 2023, Gutiérrez Vergara was outside his home in the Colonia Aviación neighbourhood, speaking with four off-duty municipal police officers, one of whom was his neighbour. A vehicle carrying armed men arrived and opened fire . The attack killed Gutiérrez Vergara and one police officer and wounded three other officers.

label: Family enrolled in the federal Protection Mechanism following the killing
quote: Following the killing, Gutiérrez Vergara’s family was enrolled in the federal Protection Mechanism.

label: Members of SEDENA force their way into the family home; soldiers stop the children, push them to the ground at gunpoint, and detain them
quote: On 25 October 2024, approximately one year after the journalist’s murder, members of SEDENA forced their way into the family home in the same Colonia Aviación neighbourhood. According to family accounts and security footage, soldiers stopped the children as they were closing their gate, forcibly entered the residence and pulled them outside, pushed them to the ground at gunpoint, and detained them.

label: Investigation into the killing open; no progress reported as of the date of this report
quote: No progress on the investigation into Gutiérrez Vergara’s killing has been reported as of the date of this report.

label: Found dead from a gunshot wound to the head in his grey Hyundai Elantra, Colonia Fronteriza Alta, Ciudad Juárez
quote: In the early hours of 16 November 2023, Villagómez Tapia was found dead from a gunshot wound to the head while seated in the driver’s seat of his grey Hyundai Elantra in the Colonia Fronteriza Alta neighbourhood of Ciudad Juárez.

label: Authorities arrest three suspects; Jesús Adrián CL and Carlos Miguel HH found in possession of two of Villagómez Tapia's mobile phones
quote: Authorities initially arrested three suspects. Jesús Adrián CL (“El Monky”) and Carlos Miguel HH were apprehended in the hours following the killing and found in possession of two mobile phones belonging to Villagómez Tapia.

label: Johan CB detained on federal firearms charges
quote: A third suspect, Johan CB, was detained on federal firearms charges.

label: The Chihuahua state prosecutor characterizes the killing as likely a robbery rather than connected to the victim's journalism
quote: The Chihuahua state prosecutor characterized the killing as likely connected to a robbery rather than to Villagómez Tapia’s journalism, though he stated the journalistic motive was not ruled out.

label: The trial begins
quote: The trial began on 13 November 2024.

label: A three-judge tribunal of the Chihuahua Judicial Branch acquits CL and HH
quote: On 28 November 2024, a three-judge tribunal of the Chihuahua Judicial Branch unanimously acquitted CL and HH, finding that the prosecution had failed to present sufficient evidence of their participation in the homicide.

label: The presiding judge identifies multiple inconsistencies in the investigation, including the handling of key ballistic evidence
quote: The presiding judge identified multiple inconsistencies in the investigation, including the handling of key ballistic evidence: the shell casing from the bullet that killed Villagómez Tapia was not discovered until nine hours after the crime, when the vehicle was already in the prosecutor’s compound, and forensic analysts had failed to conduct swabs of the rear door handles to determine whether anyone had been in the back seat at the time of the shooting.

label: Villagómez Tapia's widow tells El Heraldo de Juárez she is deeply hurt and outraged by the verdict
quote: Villagómez Tapia’s widow told El Heraldo de Juárez she was deeply hurt and outraged by the verdict, stating that her husband’s killers had spent only a year in prison.

label: The Chihuahua Attorney General's Office announces it will appeal
quote: The Chihuahua Attorney General’s Office announced it would appeal.

label: Latest reporting: the third defendant, Johan CB, remains incarcerated at the Cereso No. 3 state prison on federal firearms charges
quote: According to the latest reporting on 30 November 2024, The third defendant, Johan CB, remains incarcerated at the Cereso No. 3 state prison on federal firearms charges.

label: The Asociación de Periodistas de Ciudad Juárez condemns the acquittal
quote: The Asociación de Periodistas de Ciudad Juárez condemned the acquittal, stating that someone in the prosecutorial chain had failed to do their job.

label: Maynor Ramón Ramírez attacked with gunfire outside his carpet cleaning business in the Lázaro Cárdenas neighbourhood, near the “El Ahuate” market, Apatzingán, Michoacán; employee Juan Manuel also injured
quote: At approximately 8:30 p.m., Ramírez was standing outside a carpet cleaning business he owned in the Lázaro Cárdenas neighbourhood, near the “El Ahuate” market, when he was attacked with gunfire.

label: Ramírez shot at the intersection of Lázaro Cárdenas and Francisco I. Madero avenues in Apatzingán — the first attempt on his life; reports conflict on the wound's location; he recovered and continued his journalistic work
quote: On 11 October 2016, he had been shot while at the intersection of Lázaro Cárdenas and Francisco I. Madero avenues in Apatzingán.

label: The Attorney General’s Office of the State of Michoacán initiates an investigation file
quote: The Attorney General’s Office of the State of Michoacán initiated an investigation file.

label: Four photojournalists come under fire near a military barracks in Chilpancingo, Guerrero, while returning from covering the murder of a bus driver
quote: On the same date, four photojournalists in Chilpancingo, Guerrero, came under fire while returning together from covering the murder of a bus driver that had taken place that morning.

label: The Attorney General’s Office states that a joint operation involving state and local police, the National Guard, and the Army was initiated to locate the assailant
quote: The Attorney General’s Office stated that a joint operation involving state and local police, the National Guard, and the Army had been initiated to locate the assailant.

label: The Inter American Press Association condemns the attacks
quote: The Inter American Press Association condemned the attacks.

label: Three other journalists abducted and held for days in Taxco, Guerrero, days before the 28 November 2023 attacks; released without explanation
quote: The attacks of 28 November 2023 came just days after three other journalists had been abducted and held for days in Taxco, Guerrero, before being released without explanation.

label: Published a report on the murder of a relative of a candidate in Tetecala, Morelos
quote: He had also recently published a report on the murder of a relative of a candidate for the municipal elections in Tetecala, Morelos.

label: Participated in an event organised by Movimiento Ciudadano
quote: The day before his murder, on 25 April, he participated in an event organised by the centre-left political party Movimiento Ciudadano.

date_as_written: On the day of his abduction and killing
label: Posted a short video announcing he possessed information on corruption involving candidates
quote: On the day of his abduction and killing, Figueroa posted a short video announcing that he possessed information on corruption involving candidates for the upcoming 2 June state and federal elections.

label: Abducted by armed gunmen shortly after dropping his daughters at school in Cuernavaca
quote: On the morning of 26 April 2024, armed gunmen abducted Figueroa shortly after he dropped off his two daughters at their school in Cuernavaca, approximately 50 miles south of Mexico City.

label: Captors demanded a ransom from Figueroa’s wife over at least three calls, threatening to kill her if she called the police
quote: His unidentified captors contacted his wife, Esmeralda, on at least three occasions and demanded a ransom in exchange for his release. label: Wife delivered an undisclosed ransom near the borders of Cuernavaca, close to Ocuilan
quote: His wife delivered an undisclosed sum at the agreed location near the borders of Cuernavaca, close to the city of Ocuilan.

label: Figueroa’s body found with a fatal gunshot wound to the head, inside a white Ford Ikon in Coajomulco
quote: Despite payment of the ransom, after receipt of an anonymous telephone call, Figueroa’s body was discovered later that evening inside a white Ford Ikon on a dirt road in Coajomulco, north of Cuernavaca. He had suffered a fatal gunshot wound to the head.

label: Body of a second, unidentified man found outside the vehicle
quote: The body of a second, unidentified man was found outside the vehicle.

label: Mechanism official told CPJ the office had no prior knowledge of threats against Figueroa
quote: An official of the Mechanism told CPJ on 26 April 2024 that the office had no prior knowledge of any threats against Figueroa.

label: Acá en el Show office broken into twice, in November and December 2023
quote: Montes noted that the Acá en el Show office had been broken into twice — in November and December 2023 — although nothing was reported stolen.

label: Morelos state prosecutor’s office opened an investigation into the murder
quote: The Morelos state prosecutor’s office opened an investigation.

label: State attorney general announced Figueroa’s death was possibly linked to his work as a reporter
quote: On 29 April 2024, the state attorney general announced at a press conference that Figueroa’s death was “possibly linked to his work as a reporter,” but provided no further details.

label: Killing condemned by the IACHR Special Rapporteur, the UNESCO Director-General, and ARTICLE 19
quote: The killing was condemned by the IACHR Special Rapporteur for Freedom of Expression, the UNESCO Director-General, and ARTICLE 19.

label: RSF joined a special commission assisting the Morelos prosecutor’s office in investigating the murder
quote: RSF joined a special commission of journalists and press freedom defenders assisting the Morelos state prosecutor’s office in investigating the murder.

date_as_written: a few days before his murder
label: Victim of an attempted carjacking days before the murder
quote: Olivier Rodríguez’s vehicle had been stolen (a completed carjacking) a few days before his murder, though he had recovered it.

label: Reported missing by relatives after stopping responding to messages following a local council meeting, Guadalupe Pantzingo neighborhood
quote: He was reported missing by his relatives on the night of 6 May 2024 after he stopped responding to messages following a local council meeting in the Guadalupe Pantzingo neighborhood.

label: Body found abandoned in a taxi cab, exhibiting signs of violence
quote: His body was found the following day, abandoned in a taxi cab, exhibiting signs of violence.

label: IACHR Special Rapporteur for Freedom of Expression condemns the murder and calls for a diligent investigation
quote: The IACHR Special Rapporteur for Freedom of Expression condemned Olivier Rodríguez’s murder and called on the competent Mexican authorities to conduct a diligent investigation to clarify the facts and identify those responsible.

date_as_written: As of the date of this report
label: No person publicly reported as charged or convicted in connection with the killing
quote: As of the date of this report, no person has been publicly reported as charged or convicted in connection with Olivier Rodríguez’s killing.

label: Unidentified men in a red truck yell death threats at the reporter's bodyguards at the front gate of his Apizaco residence, declaring «kill us all»
quote: On 20 May 2024, at approximately 7:00 p.m., unidentified men driving a red truck passed by Amaro’s residence in Apizaco, Tlaxcala, and yelled death threats at the reporter’s bodyguards stationed at the front gate, declaring that they were going to “kill us all.”

label: Reporting trip five days earlier to the municipality of Ocotlán, accompanied by human rights activist Viridiana Baena Leyva, a member of Madres Buscadoras
quote: Amaro told CPJ that he believed the threats were possibly related to a reporting trip he had taken five days earlier, on 15 May, to the nearby municipality of Ocotlán, accompanied by human rights activist Viridiana Baena Leyva, a member of Madres Buscadoras (Searching Mothers)

label: After leaving Ocotlán, observed by several individuals in the area and followed for more than 10 miles by a state police vehicle
quote: Amaro and Baena had travelled to Ocotlán to investigate rumours of clandestine graves. Upon arrival, they were observed by several individuals in the area, and when they departed, a state police vehicle followed them for more than 10 miles.

label: Sustained and well-documented pattern of violence and intimidation against Amaro dating to 2019
quote: The May 2024 threats were part of a sustained and well-documented pattern of violence and intimidation against Amaro dating to 2019

label: Campaign of harassment including physical surveillance of himself, his wife and his children, hacking of his website and defamatory Facebook posts
quote: According to his interviews with Amnesty International and CPJ, Amaro has been subjected to a campaign of harassment including physical surveillance of himself, his wife, and his children; hacking of his website; and defamatory posts on Facebook accusing him of criminal activity.

label: Aggressors attempt to force him off the road while driving, on multiple occasions
quote: On multiple occasions, aggressors attempted to force him off the road while driving.

label: A gunman on a motorbike fires shots at him
quote: A gunman on a motorbike fired shots at him.

label: Intruders attempt to break into his home and fire shots at his property
quote: Intruders attempted to break into his home and fired shots at his property.

label: One of his pet dogs is fatally poisoned
quote: One of his pet dogs was fatally poisoned.

label: Allegedly threatened and harassed by officers of the Tetla police force while reporting on a farmers' protest; a commanding officer allegedly tells him «We are going to kill you»
quote: On 15 April 2020, officers of the Tetla police force allegedly threatened and harassed Amaro while he was reporting on a farmers’ protest, with a commanding officer allegedly telling him, “We are going to kill you.”

label: The mayor of Tetla de la Solidaridad, Eleazar Molina Pérez, tries to run him off the highway by attempting to ram his car
quote: In 2021, the mayor of Tetla de la Solidaridad Eleazar Molina Pérez tried to run Amaro off the highway by attempting to ram into his car; no charges were filed against the mayor.

label: No charges filed against the mayor for the highway ramming
quote: no charges were filed against the mayor.

label: Three men claiming to be members of the Sinaloa cartel offer him money to suppress stories about corrupt police officers and to publish defamatory content; Amaro declines
quote: In late 2023, three men claiming to be members of the Sinaloa cartel approached Amaro and offered him money to suppress stories about corrupt police officers and to publish defamatory content targeting those who refused the cartel’s demands. Amaro declined.

label: Chased by an unknown individual in a vehicle who attempts to ram his car; the Mechanism bodyguard driving evades the attacker
quote: In January 2024, Amaro was chased by an unknown individual in a vehicle who attempted to ram his car; the Mechanism bodyguard driving managed to evade the attacker.

label: Arrested for filming state police officers extorting citizens
quote: In November 2021, Amaro was arrested for filming state police officers extorting citizens.

label: Amaro further reports that Alfredo «N,» the former Secretary of Public Security of Tlaxcala, ordered state police to photograph his family and track his movements
quote: He further reported that Alfredo “N,” the former Secretary of Public Security of Tlaxcala — who is currently a fugitive facing charges of enforced disappearance—ordered state police to photograph Amaro’s family and track his movements.

label: Enrols in the federal Mechanism in 2019, after it took «months» to respond to his initial requests for help
quote: He enrolled in the Mechanism in 2019 but told Amnesty International and CPJ that it took “months” for the Mechanism to respond to his initial requests for help.

label: Panic button provided only after approximately six months; bodyguards not assigned until 2021
quote: Even after enrolment, it took approximately six months for the Mechanism to provide him with a panic button, and bodyguards were not assigned until 2021.

label: A Mechanism-provided vehicle has faulty brakes and the private security company monitoring his panic button frequently fails to respond to requests for help
quote: One of the vehicles the Mechanism provided for his protection detail had faulty brakes, and the private security company tasked with monitoring his panic button frequently failed to respond to requests for help.

label: The Mechanism reassesses his security situation and concludes he is no longer at risk
quote: In late July 2023, the Mechanism reassessed Amaro’s security situation and concluded that he was no longer at risk.

label: Facing the prospect of losing his bodyguards, Amaro hires a lawyer and files an amparo (injunction)
quote: Facing the prospect of losing his bodyguards and being reduced to a panic button and police visits as his sole protective measures, Amaro hired a lawyer and filed an amparo (injunction).

label: A judge rules in his favour, blocking the removal of his four bodyguards; the long-term status of his protection remains uncertain
quote: A judge ruled in his favour in August 2023, blocking the removal of his four bodyguards, although the long-term status of his protection remained uncertain.

label: The evaluation states that one of the three men who attempted to bribe him had been arrested, ignoring that the other two remained at large
quote: Moreover, the evaluation stated that Amaro was no longer in danger because one of the three men who had attempted to bribe him had been arrested — ignoring that the other two remained at large.

label: CPJ's telephone calls to the Tlaxcala State Prosecutor's Office regarding the latest threats are not answered
quote: CPJ’s telephone calls to the Tlaxcala State Prosecutor’s Office on 21 and 22 May 2024 regarding the latest threats were not answered.

label: A Mechanism official confirms the agency is aware of the threats and is investigating, describing Amaro's protection schedule as «one of the strongest»
quote: A Mechanism official confirmed to CPJ that the agency was aware of the threats and was investigating, describing Amaro’s protection schedule as “one of the strongest.”

label: No arrests in connection with the 20 May 2024 threats publicly reported
quote: No arrests in connection with the 20 May 2024 threats have been publicly reported.

label: Threatened with a firearm by a state police officer in relation to his reporting
quote: Amaro was threatened with a firearm by a state police officer in relation to his reporting in June 2024.

label: Amaro calls local police, who refuse to arrest the officer
quote: Amaro called local police, who refused to arrest the officer.

label: Amaro leaves Mexico to live in Spain for his safety
quote: Amaro left Mexico to live in Spain for his safety between September 2024 and September 2025.

label: Relocates back to Mexico; faces more death threats and harassment from various entities
quote: He has since relocated back to Mexico, and faced more death threats and harassment from various entities.

label: Realidades publishes a report stating the deployment of soldiers and police officers had failed to stem the violence in Chiapas
quote: One day before his disappearance, on 26 June 2024, Realidades published a report stating that the deployment of thousands of soldiers and police officers to Chiapas had failed to stem the violence related to turf wars between criminal gangs

label: Culebro Morales reported missing by his relatives
quote: Culebro Morales was reported missing by his relatives on 27 June 2024.

label: Body discovered in a roadside ditch near the Ocozocoautla-Arriaga toll highway
quote: Culebro Morales was reported missing by his relatives on 27 June 2024. The following day, his body was discovered in a roadside ditch at approximately kilometre 20 of the Ocozocoautla-Arriaga toll highway, near the Tierra y Libertad ejido in the municipality of Jiquipilas.

label: Family reports that Culebro Morales had received threats in the past
quote: According to Culebro Morales’ family, he had received some threats in the past.

label: Chiapas State Attorney General's Office confirms it opened a murder investigation; body transferred for autopsy
quote: The Chiapas State Attorney General’s Office confirmed that it opened an investigation into the murder through its Fiscalía de Distrito Centro and that the body was transferred to the Forensic Medical Service for autopsy.

label: No person publicly reported as charged or convicted as of the date of the report
quote: As of the date of this report, no person has been publicly reported as charged or convicted in connection with Culebro Morales’s murder.

label: Victim of an assassination attempt at his home; an unidentified man arrives armed with a firearm and asks for him by name
quote: Several years earlier, in November 2022, Martínez was the victim of an assassination attempt, when an unidentified man arrived at Martínez’s home armed with a firearm and asked for him by name.

label: Under active police protection provided by the Celaya municipal government after the first attempt on his life
quote: At the time of his killing, Martínez was under active police protection provided by the Celaya municipal government  after the first attempt on his life.

label: Reportedly requests protection by traffic officers of the Celaya municipal police force
quote: He reportedly requested protection by traffic officers, explaining that he “trusted” that unit of the Celaya municipal police force.

label: Incorporated into state protection on 28 November 2022
quote: Although Martínez’s preferences are reported in multiple outlets, there are some conflicting reports about the role of his municipal protection versus his state and federal protection, which he was incorporated into on 28 November 2022 and 12 January 2023 respectively.

label: Incorporated into federal protection on 12 January 2023
quote: Although Martínez’s preferences are reported in multiple outlets, there are some conflicting reports about the role of his municipal protection versus his state and federal protection, which he was incorporated into on 28 November 2022 and 12 January 2023 respectively.

label: Shot and killed while travelling in the back seat of a municipal police vehicle assigned to his protection detail; occupants of a white pickup truck open fire; two bodyguards and a woman in another vehicle wounded
quote: On the evening of 4 August 2024, Martínez was travelling in the back seat of a municipal police vehicle assigned to him as part of his protection detail. A white pickup truck overtook the vehicle and its occupants opened fire with long-range firearms. Martínez was struck by bullets in the head and body. His two bodyguards, who returned fire at the assailants, were wounded. A woman travelling in another vehicle was also struck by a stray bullet. Martínez was rushed to a hospital in Celaya but did not survive his injuries.

label: Completed a live Facebook broadcast from the scene of a traffic accident minutes before his death, criticising the poor infrastructure at the site
quote: Minutes before his death, he had completed a live Facebook broadcast from the scene of a traffic accident, in which he criticised the poor infrastructure at the site.

label: Guanajuato State Human Rights Commission finds Jesús Ignacio Rivera Peralta, Secretary of Security of Celaya at the time of the murder, failed to safeguard Martínez by assigning bodyguards inconsistent with the Mechanisms' recommendations
quote: In January 2025, the Guanajuato State Human Rights Commission found Jesús Ignacio Rivera Peralta—Secretary of Security of Celaya at the time of Martínez’s murder—to have failed to safeguard the journalist, by assigning bodyguards that were not consistent with the recommendations of the federal and state Mechanisms that Martínez was already protected by.

label: Several of the Human Rights Commission's orders against Rivera Peralta not complied with as of 5 August 2025
quote: As of 5 August 2025, several of these orders had not been complied with.

label: Guanajuato State Attorney General's Office announces it opened an investigation and assigned a forensic and operational team to identify those responsible
quote: The Guanajuato State Attorney General’s Office announced that it had opened an investigation and assigned a forensic and operational team to clarify the facts and identify those responsible.

label: Deputy Security Minister Luis Rodríguez Bucio confirms at the presidential morning press conference that Martínez was the third journalist murdered in Mexico in 2024
quote: At the presidential morning press conference, Deputy Security Minister Luis Rodríguez Bucio confirmed that Martínez was the third journalist murdered in Mexico in 2024.

label: No person publicly reported as charged or convicted in connection with Martínez's murder as of the date of the report
quote: As of the date of this report, no person has been publicly reported as charged or convicted in connection with Martínez’s murder.

label: Publishes a Facebook post denouncing the widespread extortion of businesses in the Frailesca region (cobro de piso)
quote: Hours before the attack, Grajales had published a post on his Facebook page denouncing the widespread extortion of businesses in the Frailesca region through the practice of cobro de piso (protection rackets), writing that the extortion applied equally to all commercial activity in the region.

label: Armed men break down the front door of his home and open fire on him
quote: At approximately 12:30 a.m. on 21 August 2024, a group of armed men broke down the front door of his home and opened fire on him.

label: Sustains multiple gunshot wounds; transported by family members to the Hospital General Bicentenario; condition reported grave
quote: Grajales sustained multiple gunshot wounds and was transported by his family members to the Hospital General Bicentenario, where his condition was reported as grave.

label: Chiapas State Attorney General's Office announces it opened an investigation into the shooting
quote: The Chiapas State Attorney General’s Office announced that it had opened an investigation into the shooting.

label: No arrests publicly reported in connection with the attack as of the date of the report
quote: As of the date of this report, no arrests have been publicly reported in connection with the attack on Grajales.
